40002404.author: पदार्थः
40002404.content: नृपतिः the king, रामम् Rama, सन्दिश्य having instructed, पुरोहितम् priest, वशिष्ठम् Vasistha, समाहूय summoning, श्वः on the following day, भाविनि about to take place, अभिषेचने with regard to coronation, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002404.author: Translation
40002404.content: The king having instructed Rama summoned Vasistha, the priest and spoke to him about the coronation that was to take place on the following day

40002405.author: पदार्थः
40002405.content: तपोधन O sage whose wealth is asceticism, गच्छ go, अद्य today, यतव्रतम् strictly observing vows, काकुत्स्थम् son of the family of Kakutstha (Rama), श्रीयशोराज्यलाभाय for securing prosperity, fame and kingdom, वध्वा सह along with my daughterinlaw, उपवासम् कारय advise him to undertake fast.

40002405.author: Translation
40002405.content: Could you, O sage, whose wealth is asceticism go to Rama engaged in strict observance of vows and advise him along with Sita, my daughterinlaw to undertake fast for securing prosperity, fame and kingdom.

40002406.author: पदार्थः
40002406.content: वेदविदाम् of those who know the Vedas, वरः best, मन्त्रकोविदः skilled in mantras, सुदृढव्रतः one who is firm in his vows, भगवान् venerable, सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, तथा इति Be it so, राजानाम् king, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तम् harnessed, ब्राह्मम् befitting a brahmin, रथवरम् best of chariots, आस्थाय having mounted, रामम् to Rama, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with mantras, उपवासयितुम् to make him fast, स्वयम् personally, रामनिवेशनम् to the abode of Rama, ययौ went.

40002406.author: Translation
40002406.content: Venerabel Vasistha, the best amongst the knowers of the Vedas, skilled in mantras and firm in his vows said to the king, 'Be it so.' Thereafter,  mounted on the best of the chariots befitting a brahmin, with horses harnesed he proceeded personally to the abode of Rama to ask him to undertake a fast in accompaniment with mantras preceding the installation ceremony.

40002407.author: पदार्थः
40002407.content: वेदविदाम् of those who know the Vedas, वरः best, मन्त्रकोविदः skilled in mantras, सुदृढव्रतः one who is firm in his vows, भगवान् venerable, सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, तथा इति Be it so, राजानाम् king, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तम् harnessed, ब्राह्मम् befitting a brahmin, रथवरम् best of chariots, आस्थाय having mounted, रामम् to Rama, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with mantras, उपवासयितुम् to make him fast, स्वयम् personally, रामनिवेशनम् to the abode of Rama, ययौ went.

40002407.author: Translation
40002407.content: Venerabel Vasistha, the best amongst the knowers of the Vedas, skilled in mantras and firm in his vows said to the king, 'Be it so.' Thereafter,  mounted on the best of the chariots befitting a brahmin, with horses harnesed he proceeded personally to the abode of Rama to ask him to undertake a fast in accompaniment with mantras preceding the installation ceremony.

40002408.author: पदार्थः
40002408.content: सः मुनिसत्तमः that foremost of ascetics, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम् shining like a mass of white clouds beaming with brightness, रामभवनम् abode of Rama, प्राप्य having reached, तिस्रः three, कक्ष्याः yards, रथेनैव mounted on the chariot itself, विवेश entered.

40002408.author: Translation
40002408.content: Having crossed the three courtyards in the chariot, that foremost of ascetics (Vasistha) entered Rams's abode, shining like a mass of white clouds.

40002409.author: पदार्थः
40002409.content: सः रामः that Rama, मानार्हम् worthy of honour, आगतम् who arrived pale, तम् ऋषिम् to the sage (Vasistha), मानयिष्यन् to pay respect, त्वरन्निव quickly, ससम्भ्रमः in great excitement, निवेशनात् from his abode, निश्चक्राम came out.

40002409.author: Translation
40002409.content: Seeing the venerable sage(Vasitha) arrive, Rama quickly came out of his abode in great excitement to receive him with honour.

40002410.author: पदार्थः
40002410.content: मनीषिणः sagacious Vasistha's, रथाभ्याशम् near the chariot, त्वरमाणः hastening steps, अभ्येत्य having approached, ततः thereafter, रथात् from the chariot, स्वयम् personally , परिगृह्य holding(his hand), अवतारयामास got him alighted.

40002410.author: Translation
40002410.content: Hastening with rapid strides, Rama approached the chariot of the sagacious Vasistha and personally helped him alight from the chariot.

40002411.author: पदार्थः
40002411.content: सः पुरोहितः च the family priest also, प्रियार्हम् lovable words, प्रश्रितम् humble, एनम् रामम् to this Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, संभाष्य having addressed him, अभिप्रसाद्य च and making him gratified, हर्षयन् causing him delight, इति thus, उवाच said.

40002411.author: Translation
40002411.content: The family priest Vasistha also, having gratified him by enquiring about his welfare, said thus to Rama, who was humble and lovable:

40002412.author: पदार्थः
40002412.content: राम O Rama, ते with you, पिता (your) father, प्रसन्नः welldisposed, यौवराज्यम् as  heirapparent, अवाप्स्यसि will obtain, भवान् you, अद्य today, सह सीतया with Sita, उपवासं करोतु undertake fast.

40002412.author: Translation
40002412.content: O Rama, welldisposed towards you, your father will declare you heirapparent. Do undertake fast today, along with Sita.

40002413.author: पदार्थः
40002413.content: नराधिपः the king, पिता father, दशरथः Dasaratha, प्रातः early in the morning, त्वाम् you, नहुषः Nahusha, ययातिं यथा like Yayati, प्रीत्या with affection, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ता हि will coronate .

40002413.author: Translation
40002413.content: Your father, king Dasaratha, will be pleased to coronate you as heirapparent early tomorrow morning as Nahusa did (to his son) Yayati.

40002414.author: पदार्थः
40002414.content: सः मुनिः that ascetic(Vasistha), इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, यतव्रतम् observing vow, वैदेह्या सहितम्  together with Sita, रामम् Rama, तदा then, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with sacred hymns, उपवासम् fast, कारयामास made (to undertake).

40002414.author: Translation
40002414.content: The ascetic (Vasistha) having thus spoken to Rama made him undertake fast along with Sita in accompaniment with sacred hymns.

40002415.author: पदार्थः
40002415.content: ततः thereafter, राज्ञः king's, गुरुः preceptor, सः he, (Vasistha), रामेण by Rama, यथावत् duly, अर्चितः honoured, काकुत्स्थम् the descendant of Kakutstha (Rama), अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, रामनिवेशनात् from the abode of Rama, ययौ departed.

40002415.author: Translation
40002415.content: Thereafter, Vasistha, preceptor of the king duly honoured by the descendant of Kakutstha (Rama) left his abode.

40002416.author: पदार्थः
40002416.content: रामोऽपि Rama also, प्रियंवदैः talking affectionately, सुहृद्भि: सह in the company of friends, तत्र there, आसीनः being seated, अथ thereafter, सभाजितः having been honoured, सर्वशः in all ways, तान् them, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, विवेश entered (his apartment).

40002416.author: Translation
40002416.content: Rama also sat for a while in the company of his sweettongued friends and duly  honoured by them in every way took  leave  of them and entered his apartment.

40002417.author: पदार्थः
40002417.content: ﻿ तदा then, हृष्टनारीनरयुतम् filled with cheerful men and women, रामवेश्म Rama's residence, मत्तद्विजगणम् multitude of intoxicated birds, प्रफुल्लनलिनम् with fullblown lotuses, सरः यथा like a lake, बभौ was splendid.

40002417.author: Translation
40002417.content: ﻿ The residence of Rama, full of cheerful men and women, looked splendid like a lake with fullblown lotuses flocked by multitudes of intoxicated birds.

40002418.author: पदार्थः
40002418.content: सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, राजभवनप्रख्यात् resembling a royal palace, तस्मात् from that, रामनिवेशनात् abode of Rama, निर्गत्य having emerged, जनसंवृतम् filled with people, मार्गम् highway, ददृशे beheld.

40002418.author: Translation
40002418.content: Vasistha thereafter emerged from the abode of Rama resembling a royal palace and beheld the highways filled with people.

40002419.author: पदार्थः
40002419.content: अयोध्यायाम् in the city of Ayodhya, राजमार्गाः royal highways, समन्ततः on all sides, बृन्दबृन्दैः crowds of, कुतूहलजनैः by curious people, वृताः surrounded, अभिसम्बाधाः बभूवु: were jammed.

40002419.author: Translation
40002419.content: The royal highways in the city of Ayodhya were jammed on all sides with groups of curious people.

40002420.author: पदार्थः
40002420.content: तदा then, जनबृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतः the exultation of the multitudes resembled the roar of the clashing of waves, राजमार्गस्य of the highways, निस्वनः sound, सागरस्येव like that of the roaring sea, बभूव emerged.

40002420.author: Translation
40002420.content: The highways resembled the sea and the exultation of the multitudes, the roar that emanated from the clashing of waves.

40002421.author: पदार्थः
40002421.content: तदहः on that day, अयोध्यानगरी the city of Ayodhya, सिक्तसम्मृष्टरथ्या हि with thoroughfares sprinkled with water and swept, वनमालिनी surrounded with gardens, समुच्छ्रितगृहध्वजा आसीत् banners raised high on the houses.

40002421.author: Translation
40002421.content: On that day, the thoroughfares of the city of Ayodhya, surrounded with (pleasure) gardens, were sprinkled with water and swept. The flags (on the top) of the houses were raised high.

40002422.author: पदार्थः
40002422.content: ﻿ तदा then, सस्त्रीबालाबलः with women, children, and weak, old persons, अयोध्यानिलयः living in Ayodhya, जनः people, रामाभिषेकम् coronation of Rama, आकाङ्क्षान् desiring, रवे: उदयम् sunrise, आकाङ्क्षत् eagerly desired.

40002422.author: Translation
40002422.content: ﻿ Then all the people living in Ayodhya including women, children and aged alike wishing to see the coronation of Rama eagerly waited for the sunrise.

40002423.author: पदार्थः
40002423.content: ﻿ प्रजालङ्कारभूतम् like an ornament for people, जनस्य for men, आनन्दवर्धनम् enhancing joy, तम् अयोध्यामहोत्सवम् that great festival of Ayodhya, द्रष्टुम् to witness, जनः men, उत्सुकः अभूत् became anxious.

40002423.author: Translation
40002423.content: ﻿ People were anxious to witness that great festival of Ayodhya which was to them (precious) like an ornament and a source of immense joy.

40002424.author: पदार्थः
40002424.content: पुरोहितः priest (Vasistha), एवम् in this way, जनसम्बाधम् thronged with men, तं राजमार्गम् that highway, तं जनौघम् crowds of men, व्यूहन्निव like dividing (into two tracts), शनैः slowly, राजकुलम् royal palace, ययौ went.

40002424.author: Translation
40002424.content: The priest (Vasistha), beholding the overcrowded highway forced his passage through the crowds of men dividing them into two tracts and slowly entered the royal palace.

40002425.author: पदार्थः
40002425.content: सः he, सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यम् looking like the peak of a mountain covered with white clouds, प्रासादम् royal palace, अधिरुह्य having ascended, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati, शक्रेणेव like Indra, नरेन्द्रेण with king, समीयाय met.

40002425.author: Translation
40002425.content: Having ascended the royal palace resembling the peak of a mountain covered with white clouds, Vasistha approached the king like  Brihaspati meeting Indra.

40002426.author: पदार्थः
40002426.content: नृपः king, आगतम् who had arrived, तम् him, अभिप्रेक्ष्य having seen, राजासनम् the throne, हित्वा after leaving, पप्रच्छ enquired, सः च he also, तत् that, कृतम् performed, इति thus, तस्मै him, अभ्यवेदयत् informed.

40002426.author: Translation
40002426.content: On seeing Vasistha the king descended from the throne and enquired whether he had performed the mission to which the ascetic replied affirmatively.

40002427.author: पदार्थः
40002427.content: तदा then, सह आसीनाः seated with him, सभासदः courtiers, तेन तुल्यम् एव in the same way as he (Dasaratha) did, पुरोहितम् to the priest, पूजयन्तः to pay obeisance, आसनेभ्यः from their seats, समुत्तस्थुः rose.

40002427.author: Translation
40002427.content: All those present in the assembly with him (the king) also got up from their seats as he (Dasaratha) did and paid their obeisance to Vasistha.

40002428.author: पदार्थः
40002428.content: राजा the king, गुरुणा by the preceptor, अभ्यनुज्ञातः having been permitted, तम्  मनुजौघम् that assembly of men, विसृज्य having disposed, सिंहः lion, गिरिगुहामिव like the cave of a mountain, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, विवेश entered.

40002428.author: Translation
40002428.content: The king then, dully permitted by the preceptor, disposed the assembly of men and stepped into his inner apartment, like a lion entering the cave of a mountain.

40002429.author: पदार्थः
40002429.content: पार्थिवः the king, अग्य्रवेषप्रमदाजनाकुलम् thronged with excellently attired women, महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमम् equal to the palace of Mahendra, तं निवेशनम् that inner apartment, विदीपयन् illumining, चारु beautiful, तारागणसङ्कुलम् crowded with stars, नभः sky, शशीव like Moon, विवेश entered.

40002429.author: Translation
40002429.content: The king entered the inner apartment thronged with excellently attired women which looked like the palace of Mahendra. He resembled the beautiful Moon that illuminates the sky crowded with stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
